key_insights: ~20% default rate -- imbalanced but not extreme (imbalance ratio ~4:1)
Interest rate, FICO score, and DTI are the strongest individual predictors of default
Missingness is concentrated in credit-history features (mort_acc, pub_rec_bankruptcies)
5 leakage groups identified (repayment, dates, delinquency, hardship, settlement) -- 145+ columns must be removed before modeling
Loan-to-income ratio separates defaulters from non-defaulters more clearly than raw loan amount or income alone
Grade A borrowers have <5% default rate; Grade G borrowers exceed 40%
All tested bivariate differences are statistically significant (p < 0.001)
Multicollinear groups exist (FICO triplet, loan_amnt/installment) -- dimensionality reduction warranted
